domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite one or more fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag subtraction steps that use already-aligned fractions.
Do not tag normalization of a whole number or improper mixed number unless the step also performs denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as expressing a whole as a whole plus zero fractional part or converting an improper mixed form to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready quantities.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless the step also rewrites the overall number form.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators over a shared denominator and subtracting whole-number parts in mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a step performs both whole-part and fraction-part subtraction in the same step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag final simplification or final answer formatting when no subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole-number part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to continue subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole-number part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag initial normalization such as rewriting a whole as a whole plus 0 over a denominator unless borrowing is also performed in that step.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction unless the borrowing action is present.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or simplify it to a whole number or zero when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor after subtraction.
Tag when a result like 0 over n is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed or combined result is simplified to an integer because the fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms answer if no simplification action is shown.
Do not tag merely combining whole and fraction parts unless reduction or zero simplification is explicitly performed.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts, or recognize that only a fraction or whole number remains, to state the final result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a fractional part of zero is omitted to present an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly states the final assembled form.
Do not tag initial rewriting of numbers before subtraction.
